# OrderDirection enumeration

Specifies the direction of a sort operation in a SQL query.

```csharp
public enum OrderDirection
```

## Values

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ascending | `0` | Sorts in ascending order (e.g., A to Z, 1 to 10). |
| Descending | `1` | Sorts in descending order (e.g., Z to A, 10 to 1). |
